law_name: Law No. 08-024 of 23 July 2008 Laying Down the Regime of Literary and Artistic Property
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Art. 44); collaborative works 70 years after last surviving author's death (Art. 45); anonymous/pseudonymous works Art. 46
notes: WIPO Lex ML015; repeals three earlier texts. Mali's copyright office name not confirmed (OMDA search returned Madagascar).
